'''2012 Canadian Nationals Tim DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tim]] at [[2012 Canadian Nationals]] (Nationals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[No Money, No Parts, No Deal! (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Nationals
